papers.title: Quantum Complex-Valued Self-Attention Model
papers.source_fact: QCSAM uses complex query-key inner products, coherent value-state combinations, trainable complex weighting and subsequent quantum processing.
papers.transfer: General complex quantum value aggregation already has precedents. Our proposed effect remains a positive Born measurement over separate token projectors, with signed utility readout and no coherent token erasure.
papers.unread: Later complex embedding equations, circuit details, resource claims, experimental sections and supplements; reported accuracies not adopted

papers.title: Value-aware Approximate Attention
papers.source_fact: Sparse approximation should target the value-weighted attention output; its optimal index ranking need not match attention-score ranking. The paper discusses oracle expressivity and does not supply our task-utility guarantee.
papers.transfer: Utility must be included when choosing an effect; our proposal is a new forward rule, not sparse approximation of a fixed attention output.
papers.unread: Appendices and code; no experiments reproduced

papers.title: Matrix Exponentiated Gradient Updates for On-line Learning and Bregman Projection
papers.source_fact: Real symmetric positive-definite parameters admit normalized matrix exponentiated-gradient updates derived from von Neumann divergence. The implicit proximal solution and explicit linearized update differ.
papers.transfer: We explicitly solve a Hermitian linear Gibbs variational problem, not the original convex square-loss learning task; no source regret theorem is transferred.
papers.unread: Later loss bounds, full convergence proofs, kernel-learning experiments and appendices
